description: This file modifies shader code to ensure certain code executes at the end of the shader's main function, handling cases where main() contains return statements by replacing main() with a wrapper that calls the original main and then executes additional code.

classes.name: ContainsReturnTraverser
classes.description: A traverser class that checks if a shader node contains a return statement.

methods.name: ContainsReturn
methods.description: Checks if a given shader node contains a return statement.

methods.name: WrapMainAndAppend
methods.description: Replaces the main() function with a wrapper that calls the original main and then executes additional code.

methods.name: RunAtTheEndOfShader
methods.description: Main function that appends code to run at the end of the shader's main function, handling return statements appropriately.
